title: Enhancing Time Series Momentum Strategies Using Deep Neural Networks

experiment.name: Sharpe-optimised LSTM with turnover regularisation under c=10 bps

reproduction_tolerance.rule: REPRODUCED requires the exact-paper-data run to produce the predeclared LSTM+Reg Sharpe within absolute tolerance 0.10 and preserve the paper's stated method/data/split contract. A numerically close substitute-data run is never REPRODUCED.

data_gate.license_state: COMMERCIAL_DATASET; redistribution rights not established by the paper

method_contract.ex_ante_volatility_estimator: exponentially weighted moving standard deviation with 60-day span
method_contract.sharpe_loss: negative annualized sample Sharpe over strategy returns, annualization sqrt(252)
method_contract.transaction_cost: c times absolute daily change in volatility-scaled position; c=10 bps for the locked experiment
method_contract.hyperparameter_selection: 50-iteration random search using validation loss; max 100 epochs; early stopping patience 25
forbidden_substitutions: different futures vendor or public proxy data
current continuous-futures construction without proof of the paper's ratio-adjusted CLC series
cross-sectional momentum baseline in place of paper baselines

author_code_and_data.pinned_paper_data_link: Pinnacle Data Corp CLC Database reference only

fail_closed_rule: If exact paper data provenance, version, license/access state, or required split/method inputs fail their gate, emit BLOCKED before model fitting. Do not manufacture final metrics.
